title: Objects and their states come from an ER diagram; collected fields are not invented
note: AI-AG-002, AI-INP-005, AI-BR-05: the diagram's objects and their cardinality are recorded, the states the business names are a lifecycle, and fields nobody described become a question instead of attributes.

items.label: anc-model.mmd
items.content:
erDiagram
  WOMAN ||--o{ PREGNANCY : has
  PREGNANCY ||--|{ ANTENATAL_VISIT : has
  PREGNANCY: registered, inCare, delivered

items.label: requirements/req.delivery.record
items.content: {"businessKey": "req.delivery.record", "statement": "The attending midwife must record every delivery with its date, the facility and the outcome."}

expected.summary: Registered the three objects the diagram draws, with the pregnancy lifecycle it labels (registered, inCare, delivered) and the two relationships it draws. The visit block lists two fields; they are recorded as the diagram states them. Whether the delivery record is a fourth object or the pregnancy's last state is not decided by anything in the inputs, so it is asked about.

decisions.subject: entity.pregnancy

selected.option: a separate entity with its own lifecycle

alternatives.reasonRejected: A woman can have several pregnancies; folding them into her states would lose the history the diagram draws as one-to-many.

decisions.rationale: The diagram gives pregnancy its own states and its own relationships, which is what makes it an object rather than a flag.

transitions.trigger: the first antenatal contact is recorded

value.name: has antenatal visit
candidateExpressions: a repeating event inside the pregnancy's programme instance

questions.text: The diagram draws no delivery object, but req.delivery.record says a delivery is recorded with a date, a facility and an outcome. Is that a fourth entity, the pregnancy's delivered state, or the last visit's fields?

suggestions.text: A delivery entity linked from the pregnancy
suggestions.rationale: It carries its own outcome and can be reported on alone.

suggestions.text: The pregnancy's delivered state plus three attributes on the pregnancy
suggestions.rationale: Fewer objects, but one pregnancy could not hold two deliveries.

suggestions.text: Fields on the final antenatal visit
suggestions.rationale: Cheapest, and wrong if a delivery is ever recorded without a visit.
